Also the starver W assumed vgs≈0.7 V, so at vmid=1.05 V the current would be far above I. Starver gm/Id is now solved by bisection so vgs = vmid. Cff raised for overshoot."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":    (12e-6, 4e-6, 40e-6),      # starving current at vmid [A]
    "Ls":   (0.5, 0.15, 1.5),          # starver length [um]
    "Wr":   (0.42, 0.42, 1.5),         # ring NMOS width (PMOS = 2x)
    "Wb2":  (0.84, 0.42, 3.0),         # output inverter NMOS width (PMOS = 2x)
    "Cff":  (6e-15, 0.5e-15, 15e-15),  # feed-forward cap b1 -> vout (overshoot)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vr = spec.get("vctrl_range", [0.7, 1.4])
    vlo, vhi = vr[0], vr[1]
    vmid = 0.5 * (vlo + vhi)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    Lmin = 0.15
    I, Ls = p["I"], p["Ls"]

    # pick NMOS starver gm/Id so that its vgs equals vmid at current I (bisection)
    g_lo, g_hi = 2.0, 20.0
    for k in range(8):
        g = math.sqrt(g_lo * g_hi)
        t = lut.size("n", g, Ls, I, vds=0.4)
        if t.vgs > vmid:
            g_lo = g
        else:
            g_hi = g
    gmn = math.sqrt(g_lo * g_hi)

    msn = lut.size("n", gmn, Ls, I, vds=0.4)        # NMOS starver / bias device
    mpb = lut.size("p", 8, Ls, I, vds=0.9)          # PMOS diode
    mps = lut.size("p", 8, Ls, I, vds=0.4)          # PMOS starvers (mirror)

    Wrn = p["Wr"]; Wrp = 2.0 * Wrn
    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    n.dev("MNB", "pb", "vctrl", "vss", "vss", msn)
    n.dev("MPB", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpb)

    nodes = ["r0", "r1", "r2"]
    for i in range(3):
        a = nodes[i]; y = nodes[(i + 1) % 3]
        sp = "sp%d" % i; sn = "sn%d" % i
        n.dev("MPS%d" % i, sp, "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mps)
        n.M("MP%d" % i, y, a, sp, "vdd", "pfet", Wrp, Lmin)
        n.M("MN%d" % i, y, a, sn, "vss", "nfet", Wrn, Lmin)
        n.dev("MNS%d" % i, sn, "vctrl", "vss", "vss", msn)

    n.M("MB1P", "b1", "r0", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.84, Lmin)
    n.M("MB1N", "b1", "r0", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, Lmin)
    Wn2 = p["Wb2"]; Wp2 = 2.0 * Wn2
    n.M("MB2P", "vout", "b1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp2, Lmin)
    n.M("MB2N", "vout", "b1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn2, Lmin)
    n.C("CFF", "b1", "vout", p["Cff"])

    # ---- predictions (cheap analytic) ----
    cox = 8.5e-15; cov = 0.35e-15
    def cg(W, L): return W * L * cox + 2 * W * cov
    c_node = cg(Wrp, Lmin) + cg(Wrn, Lmin) + (Wrp + Wrn) * 0.9e-15 + 0.5e-15
    c_r0 = c_node + cg(0.84, Lmin) + cg(0.42, Lmin)
    cavg = (2 * c_node + c_r0) / 3
    vth = msn.vth
    vgsm = max(msn.vgs, vth + 0.05)
    def istarve(vc):
        vov = max(vc - vth, 0.02); vovm = vgsm - vth
        return I * (vov / vovm) ** 1.5
    def freq(vc):
        Is = istarve(vc)
        return 1.0 / (3 * cavg * vdd / Is + 3 * 25e-12)
    f_lo, f_mid, f_hi = freq(vlo), freq(vmid), freq(vhi)

    c_b1 = cg(Wp2, Lmin) + cg(Wn2, Lmin) + 1.2e-15 + p["Cff"]
    c_out = cl + (Wp2 + Wn2) * 0.9e-15 + p["Cff"]
    c_sw = 2 * c_node + c_r0 + c_b1 + c_out
    power = 1.3 * c_sw * vdd ** 2 * f_mid + vdd * istarve(vmid)
    cgd2 = (Wp2 + Wn2) * cov
    kick = (p["Cff"] + cgd2) / (p["Cff"] + cgd2 + c_out) * vdd * 0.3
    swing = vdd + kick
    return n, {"f_lo": f_lo, "f_mid": f_mid, "f_hi": f_hi,
               "fmin": f_lo, "fmax": f_hi,
               "tuning_ratio": f_hi / max(f_lo, 1.0),
               "kvco": (f_hi - f_lo) / (vhi - vlo),
               "swing": swing, "power": power}
```
